description: Sends a shipping request to the Global Shopaholics team for a manual quote or help with a shipment, labels or customs paperwork (e.g. heavy/oversize items, freight, multiple boxes). Nothing is charged. Call only after the user confirms details. Returns a reference id and next steps. For instant prices use get_shipping_rates instead.

length.description: Box length (cm if kg, in if lb). Optional; improves accuracy because dimensional weight applies.

unit.description: Unit for weight. Dimensions use cm with kg, inches with lb.

weight.description: Package weight (0.1–275 in the chosen unit; decimals OK). Use the expected consolidated box weight.

name: request_shipment_quote
title: Request a custom shipping quote (heavy/oversize, freight, customs paperwork)
